description: Two independent event acceptance checks. Engineering validation is recorded in the release evidence, not assigned to reviewers.

items.name: RC98 — Event task quality
items.description: Test: In a disposable workspace, run one representative event task with the intended model/provider. Read the actual agent work and final artifact. Pass: The result and division of work are useful for the demonstration; record unclear or incorrect behavior in notes.

items.name: RC98 — Event device and provider
items.description: Test: On the actual event device or installed test instance, complete one short task using its intended network/provider. Restart through the supported launcher and reopen the saved result. Coordinate installed upgrades with the deployment owner. Pass: The task works and the saved result survives; record device, version and any installation/provider error.
